properties.description: End-to-end: get_node and loop_status through the server's real request path (an in-memory service served over a pipe, the call on a runtime worker built by server_runtime with a 2 MiB stack), on a chain whose every step reads its claim as intent, 1,000 steps deep in debug and 3,000 in release, depths at which main's recursive walks overflowed a 2 MiB worker. Each case runs in a child process.
properties.name: crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/a_deep_reasoning_chain_is_answered_on_a_2_mib_worker.rs
